# id: # Prayer methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Offering dragon bones at a gilded altar in your house
note: Starts at Prayer 1 but needs 75 Construction; wiki gives 643,000 xp/h at 2,550 bones/h with both incense burners lit (252 xp per bone) with good banking and manual use.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Offering superior dragon bones at a gilded altar in your house
note: Wiki gives 1,340,000 xp/h at 2,550 bones/h with manual use and good banking; the Ironman guide names frost dragons and Vorkath as the sources of superior dragon bones.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Offering dragon bones at the Chaos Temple altar
note: Ironman guide gives around 500,000 Prayer xp/h at peak; the altar gives 350% per bone with a 50% chance the bone is not consumed, and the guide calls the method dangerous.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Offering noted dragon bones at the Chaos Temple altar
note: Pay-to-play guide gives up to 860,000 xp/h manual use (1,800,000 with superior dragon bones); unnoting costs 50 coins per note, and the UIM guide says noted bones in the Wilderness are not viable for UIM.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Grinding bones and offering them at the Ectofuntus
note: Ironman guide gives 4x Prayer xp per bone and recommends it to hardcore ironmen; the UIM guide says dragon bones give 288 xp each, and no xp/h is given for this method.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Sacrificing blessed bone shards at the libation bowl
uses: blessed bone shards=30:?;jug of blessed wine=30:?
note: Pay-to-play guide gives approximate xp/h per Prayer range using existing shards and blessed wine (the 88-99 row was cut off in our read); the Ironman guide says Children of the Sun and Prayer 30 are needed.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Reanimating ensouled giant heads from hill giants
where: Hill giants near fairy ring DJR (Chasm of Fire)
note: UIM guide gives up to about 10,000–12,000 Prayer xp/h with Adept Reanimation on the Arceuus spellbook, plus passive Melee xp; big bones from these giants can be buried for 15 xp each.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Pest Control minigame for Prayer points
note: Ironman guide gives around 40,000 xp/h at Prayer around 80 with combat level 100 and hard combat achievements (8 points per game); the UIM guide gives a base 38,000/h at 98-99 Prayer.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11 ; xp OSRS Wiki Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Safespotting blue dragons in Taverley Dungeon and offering bones at the Chaos Temple
where: Taverley Dungeon, then Chaos Temple in the Wilderness
note: UIM guide gives 15,000–25,000 xp/h with weaker spells and up to about 35,000 with Iban's Blast; the anti-dragon shield needs Dragon Slayer I started, and levels 1 to 43 take about 100 dragon bones.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Collecting big bones in the Bone Yard and offering them at the Chaos Temple
where: Bone Yard, then Chaos Temple in the Wilderness
note: UIM guide gives up to 15,000–20,000 Prayer xp/h, says the method has no requirements, and needs about 480 big bones from level 1 to 43.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Killing Wilderness green dragons with the elite Wilderness Diary
note: UIM guide gives up to about 85,000 xp/h with a dragon scimitar (95,000 with an abyssal whip); Song of the Elves is only needed for the Prifddinas respawn and the POH.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Killing Wilderness green dragons without the elite Wilderness Diary
note: UIM guide gives about 40,000 xp/h at 67 Ranged with basic gear and no deaths, and 60,000–70,000 at 99 Ranged; it lists 32 quest points and Woodcutting 57 for the Waka canoe.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Killing green dragons in the Myths' Guild basement
note: UIM guide gives 50,000–75,000 xp/h with Sinister Offering and 55,000–75,000 with a gilded altar (top end with a Construction cape); the lance is strongly recommended and the method is much worse without it.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Killing red dragons in the Forthos Dungeon and burning bones at the Sacred Bone Burner
note: UIM guide gives up to about 20,000 Prayer xp/h with hide processing (plus about 6,000 Crafting xp/h); the Sacred Bone Burner gives triple Prayer xp per bone.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11

name: Prayer from The Restless Ghost and Priest in Peril
note: One-off rewards of 1,125 Prayer xp (The Restless Ghost) and 1,406 (Priest in Peril); the wiki gives no per-hour rate.
source: OSRS Wiki Pay-to-play Prayer training, Ironman Guide/Prayer, Ultimate Ironman Guide/Prayer 2026-11-11
